questions.question: Stack vs heap lifetime?
options: Stack dies at }; heap lives until free
questions.explanation: Scope vs ownership: the core distinction.

questions.question: realloc returns NULL. Old block?
options: Still valid; caller still owns it
questions.explanation: Failure leaves the old pointer intact — never overwrite it blindly.

questions.question: vec doubles 4->8->16. Why doubling?
options: Amortized O(1) per push; fewer moves
questions.explanation: Geometric growth bounds total copies linearly.

questions.question: Which is NOT a heap sin?
questions.explanation: NULL checks are virtue; the other three corrupt or waste.

questions.question: ASan on commented-out free reports?
questions.explanation: 'Runs fine' never proves ownership — guards do.

questions.question: Kernel kalloc vs user malloc?
options: Same own/free discipline, page granularity vs byte
questions.explanation: Discipline transfers; granularity changes to 4 KiB pages.
